description: DB migration: unifi_credentials and unifi_console_routes created with Citus-safe DDL; uniques and indexes present
DB migration: existing single-key tenant in both modes backfills to one 'Default' credential and keeps every scope key and asset mapping
Unit: fleet client with one credential delegates exactly like the single client; existing consumer tests pass unchanged
Unit: routing with keys A and B — every console resolves to a reaching key, fabric consoles to B, nothing unreachable
Unit: only key A — fabric consoles yield the 'add a fabric key' warning and independent consoles sync normally
Unit: routes are reused on routine sync and re-probed on console_forbidden, credential removal and full sync
Unit: a 401 on key B marks only B; A's sites keep syncing and B's sites are neither tombstoned nor auto-resolved
Unit: two local controllers get distinct colon-free host ids and distinct scope keys
Unit/DB: saving a new local base URL without a new key is rejected, and no request is issued that carries the old key to the new destination
Unit: credential removal re-routes reachable consoles, marks the rest unreachable, and asks before unmapping sites
UI: credential list renders labels/modes/statuses/consoles-reached with no ids; add, replace, relabel, remove flows
Smoke (dev stack + simulator): two keys, one independent and one fabric site mapped, device sync and alert cycle produce assets and an offline-alert ticket for both
Docs/release: setup guide covers Independent + per-fabric keys and the release note credits Ryan at Tom's Help Desk
